claims: No. 9 seed Iowa defeated 4-seed Nebraska 77-71 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
No. 9 seed Iowa advanced to the Elite Eight for the first time since 1987.
No. 9 seed Iowa's advancement to the Elite Eight by defeating 4-seed Nebraska 77-71 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 was reported in an article from hawkeyesports.com.
The Hawkeyes were led by Ben McCollum.
Iowa rallied from a 10-point first-half deficit in Houston.
No. 9 seed Iowa faces No. 3 seed Illinois.
No. 3 seed Illinois defeated No. 2 Houston 65-55.
Iowa faces No. 3 seed Illinois on Saturday, March 28, 2026, at 5:09 p.m. CT.
The game against Illinois is for a Final Four spot.
Ben McCollum is a first-year coach.
The Elite Eight game will be on TBS.
The venue is Toyota Center, Houston, Texas.
